t2.thesis: A steep pre-earnings sector drawdown has significantly de-risked positioning, setting Lam Research up for a relief bounce if calendar Q3 execution and forward WFE commentary meet expectations.
reasons: LRCX has experienced an 11.9% 5-day selloff alongside a broader semiconductor shakeout, lowering the hurdle for a positive reaction.
Lam has delivered consistent beats and positive reaction day opens in 3 of the last 4 quarters (averaging ~8% surprise).
Counterbalanced by severe industry-wide anxiety over AI capex durability and negative peer spillover following ASML's post-earnings drop.
t2.deciding_variable: December quarter forward guidance on memory and foundry/logic WFE spending versus feared AI capex slowdown.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up by +0.041 from the 0.479 semis base rate due to an oversold tactical setup (-12% in 5 days) and proven earnings beat consistency, tempered by macro semi capex skepticism.

theses.expected: LRCX beats Q3 guidance midpoint ($8.10B rev / $2.15 EPS) and guides Q4 above consensus, sparking a short-covering relief rally.
theses.mechanism: Oversold positioning and hedge fund de-grossing into the print create sharp upside asymmetry on clean results.
theses.wrong_if: Management gives cautious December quarter guidance citing memory fab pause or tightening export control concerns.

theses.expected: LRCX reports in line with guidance but reiterates solid leading-edge demand, producing a mild rebound.
theses.mechanism: The stock already priced in substantial weakness with a 12% pullback over the preceding week.
theses.wrong_if: Investors react defensively similar to ASML, punishing even solid prints on forward-looking multiple compression.

theses.expected: Gross margins compress due to customer mix or tariffs, triggering further downward momentum.
theses.mechanism: High operational leverage means any margin softness compounds existing AI infrastructure fatigue.
theses.wrong_if: Customer support and advanced etch/deposition system shipments deliver upside margin surprise above 52%.

key_observations: Q1 FY27 (ended Sept 2026) revenue against the $8.1B guided midpoint
Non-GAAP gross margin vs the 52.0% target
Q2 FY27 revenue and EPS guidance range
Management commentary on HBM-related packaging and memory wafer fabrication equipment capex trends
